title: Tedesco brothers' data on orbs entering the water off Long Island

tellings.quote: They have some serious data of orbs off offshore. Some going into the water

plain: Two brothers, Jerry Tedesco and John Tedesco, have gathered what is described as serious data on orbs, glowing balls of light, offshore near Long Island, New York, some of them going into the water. Tim Gallaudet, a retired Navy admiral, tells Michels about their work. He raises it as a sign that unexplained objects move between the air and the sea.
